import json, re

lines = open('data/pythia-2.8b-paraphrase/generations_shard0.jsonl').readlines()
records = [json.loads(l) for l in lines]

depth1 = [r for r in records if r['depth'] == 1]

# More thorough meta-commentary detection
meta_patterns = [
    r'\bessay\b', r'\bwell written\b', r'\bgood job\b', r'\binteresting\b',
    r'\bgreat\b', r'\bpassage\b', r'\btext is\b', r'\bauthor\b',
    r'\bpiece of writing\b', r'\bnicely\b', r'\bsummary\b', r'\byour (writing|style|paper|work)\b',
    r'\bexcellent (paper|essay|article|work)\b', r'\bkeep (doing|writing|up)\b',
    r'\bI (liked|enjoyed|appreciate)\b', r'\bshould be proud\b',
    r'\bwriting style\b', r'\byou wrote\b', r'\bawesome work\b',
    r'\breview\b.*\b(this|the) (article|essay|text|paper)\b',
    r'\bbrief (summary|overview|handwritten)\b',
]

meta_count = 0
meta_examples = []
for d in depth1:
    text = d.get('text', '').strip()[:300].lower()
    is_meta = False
    matched = []
    for pat in meta_patterns:
        if re.search(pat, text):
            is_meta = True
            matched.append(pat)
    if is_meta:
        meta_count += 1
        if len(meta_examples) < 10:
            meta_examples.append((d['seed_id'], text[:150], matched))

print(f'=== DEPTH-1 QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS ===')
print(f'Total depth-1 records: {len(depth1)}')
print(f'Meta/commentary flagged: {meta_count} ({meta_count/len(depth1)*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'Substantive: {len(depth1)-meta_count} ({(len(depth1)-meta_count)/len(depth1)*100:.1f}%)')
print()

print('=== FLAGGED META EXAMPLES (first 10) ===')
for sid, txt, pats in meta_examples:
    print(f'seed={sid} [matched: {\", \".join(pats[:3])}]')
    print(f'  {txt}')
    print()

# Also check depth-2
depth2 = [r for r in records if r['depth'] == 2]
meta2 = 0
for d in depth2:
    text = d.get('text', '').strip()[:300].lower()
    for pat in meta_patterns:
        if re.search(pat, text):
            meta2 += 1
            break

print(f'=== DEPTH-2 QUANTITATIVE ANALYSIS ===')
print(f'Total depth-2 records: {len(depth2)}')
print(f'Meta/commentary flagged: {meta2} ({meta2/len(depth2)*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'Substantive: {len(depth2)-meta2} ({(len(depth2)-meta2)/len(depth2)*100:.1f}%)')
"
